verdict.summary: Round 3 confirms the round-2 approval. The diff remains fail-closed: the optimization is available only when the merge base resolves, both blobs are readable, non-comment lines match verbatim, and PyYAML parses both documents to equal values; dependency/setup, parsing, Git, and proof failures retain the existing full-run trigger. The conjunction covers the relevant YAML hazards: textual equality rejects source rewrites that PyYAML may normalize differently from GitHub Actions, while structural equality rejects edits to comment-looking or blank content inside block scalars. The selector wiring preserves independent crate and full-run triggers, and the tests exercise both proof halves, the real merge-base/blob path, dependency absence, malformed and missing inputs, decline auditing, eligibility, memoization, summary output, and mixed-path selection. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue was found.
